component.name: Loofi Pulse
component.summary: Causal KDE Plasma 6 hardware, thermal, and PSI stall monitor

description.p: Loofi Pulse is a hybrid KDE Plasma 6 hardware monitor (Panel Applet + Kirigami Studio App) designed around causal telemetry rather than raw sensor dumps. It correlates process activity, power flow, Linux PSI (Pressure Stall Information), ZRAM compression efficiency, CPU/GPU clock frequencies, and thermal headroom into clear human-readable diagnostics.
